pages.text: Every ordinary affix has an accessory of its own, 32 in all.$(br2)$(li)Worn in an alchemical accessory slot; needs 20 luck.$(li)Each has an effect of its own.$(li)While worn, monsters' $(l)affix of the same name$() has no effect on you.

$(l)Crafting$()$(br)Transmutation altar: 2 of the affix material (one as the main material), 2 alchemical source ingots and one themed item.$(br2)$(l)Recipes$()$(br)Alchemical creations drop them 10% of the time.$(br2)The $(l)Resonant Silver Charm$() raises the numbers of your other accessories by 40%.
